cycle_report.summary: Cycle 1 established the modular_engine package by extracting three core subsystems from the monolithic af_engine.py into dedicated modules: MissionManager (mission lifecycle), ExecutionEngine (stage execution and retry logic), and SnapshotManager (snapshot creation/recovery). The af_engine.py shim remains in place as atlasforge_conductor.py still imports from it. The modular_engine package is functional scaffolding with correct structure and interfaces but production logic has not yet been fully ported from af_engine.py. A HANDOFF.md was written documenting all completed work and remaining steps.
